mapper.select: SELECT LEVEL, C.* FROM (SELECT ONETALK_NO, ONETALK_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(ONETALK_WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일" HH24"시" MI"분" SS"초"') COMMENT_WRITE_DATE_BOARD, MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_NAME, PARENT_ONETALK_NO, ONETALK_DEL_FL FROM "ONETALK" LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" USING(MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "WORKER" USING(MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN "EMPLOYER" USING(MEMBER_NO) ) C WHERE ONETALK_DEL_FL = 'N' OR 0 != (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "COMMENT_BOARD" SUB WHERE SUB.PARENT_COMMENT_NO = C.ONETALK_NO AND COMMENT_DEL_FL_BOARD = 'N') START WITH PARENT_ONETALK_NO IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR ONETALK_NO = PARENT_ONETALK_NO ORDER SIBLINGS BY ONETALK_NO
